correctness.rationale: The edge-distance graph is L(F_r): 2r spokes form a clique and rim z_i meets only its two spokes. Twin spokes force one spoke landmark per page, and two one-landmark pages leave unselected spokes metrically identical; hence metric dimension>=2r-1. Every page except one chosen with two edges and one exceptional spoke resolves all edge pairs, yielding 2r*3^(r-1) bases. For doubly resolving, a singly covered page makes its selected spoke and rim have constant distance difference against all landmarks; two per page are necessary and sufficient, yielding 2r and 3^r. Independently enumerated all landmark subsets in L(F_r) for r=2,3,4 confirming exact complete basis families. Symbolic page proof covers all r>=2.
